plan: Given my value of $10, I aim to bid just below this value to maximize potential profit. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid slightly lower than my value to ensure a positive gain if I win. Assuming other rational bidders will bid close to their values, I will bid $9.9 to potentially win if their values are lower. This strategy minimizes risk while offering a chance to profit if their bids are lower than my value.

This balances winning chances and profit margin.
